name: The Murder of Beppi the Clown the Dating Sim
source:
Please do not take anything from this sequel fangame  to Beppi the Clown Dating Simulator seriously.  

There's a killer on the loose!

After murdering Studio MDHR's beloved Beppi the Clown, three witnesses try to help solve the case! Can you find them? Will you find them? 

There's 11 endings in total!

[Edited from [url=https://numituwi.itch.io/the-murder-of-beppi-the-clown-the-dating-sim]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
请别把这部《Beppi the Clown Dating Simulator》的同人续作里的任何东西当真。

有个凶手逍遥法外！

Studio MDHR笔下深受喜爱的小丑贝比遭到杀害，三名目击者试图协助破案！你能找到凶手吗？你会找到吗？

游戏共有11个结局！

[编译自[url=https://numituwi.itch.io/the-murder-of-beppi-the-clown-the-dating-sim]itch.io[/url]]
